Looking to hire a 8-a-side football pitch in Central London? Coram's Fields has the perfect facilities for lovers of the small-sided version of the beautiful game. 8-a-side football at Coram's Fields is played on 3G astroturf. So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 8-a-side football machine, Coram's Fields is the right choice for you.

If you are looking to hire the pitch for a film or photo shoot, please note that film or photo shoots must also obtain a permit from FilmFixer in advance. Please contact them on info@filmfixer.co.uk or 0207 620 0391.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off or block booking basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game or several games without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

Looking to set up regular games at Coram's Fields? Enquire about making a Regular Hire booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Regular Hire bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing consistently. Please be aware that Regular Hires will need to pay in advance for their bookings at the start of the month via standing order and will be required to sign a regular booking contract. Regular bookings are not permitted to cancel individual bookings and a one-month cancellation policy applies.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Russell Square. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue. The entry gate is at the back of the pitches, via either Mecklenburgh Square or Brunswick Gardens.

Users should note that Coram’s Fields is a children’s charity. The income received from the hire of their pitches provides essential funding for their community services. However, Coram’s Fields is principally a space dedicated to children and young people and the charity asks that all those hiring their pitches, respect their younger users (please see venue terms and conditions for more information)

Please be aware that our third pitch has both 5-a-side or 8-a-side goals available. If you would like these changed, please ask our ground staff team and they will happily change them for you.

Cancellation Policy: All ad-hoc or block bookings wishing to cancel or re-arrange a booking are required to give at least 30 days’ notice prior to the booking date to be eligible for a refund or re-scheduled match.

For full terms and conditions visit the Coram’s Fields website.
